temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites him to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but dangerously overworked and neglecting his health, and that a relaxing retreat might help him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's refusal confirms that Gary feels unable to step away because of hospital obligations, but it does not yet reveal any deeper cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is seriously overworked and currently unwilling or unable to take a break; his hospital workload is the main obstacle Ethan knows about.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, sympathetic, and perhaps disappointed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep supporting Gary and find another way to help him rest or open up.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussing work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says his problems are complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked by hospital obligations and reluctant to rest; no deeper personal issue is yet known to Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's avoidance and comment suggest that his overwork is tied to something more complicated and personal than professional duties alone.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is carrying a hidden personal burden and may be avoiding disclosure to protect Ethan; he needs nonjudgmental support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary, encourage him to open up, and offer help without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He agrees to Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has a deeper, complicated burden but does not know the specifics, and thinks Gary may now be ready to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now understands the reasons behind Gary's overwork and sees that Gary is willing to work on changing his situation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork stems from new department pressures plus personal challenges, and a better balance is achievable with task prioritization, delegation, and Ethan's support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief, empathy, compassion, and cautious hope.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and find better work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in and hears that Gary is doing better: Gary is less overwhelmed, has accepted help, and even had time for a movie last weekend, though challenges remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is working toward balance and still needs ongoing support and encouragement; progress is possible but not yet fully assured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reported efforts and improvement confirm meaningful progress and suggest that Ethan's support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making real progress toward a healthier work-life balance, is less overwhelmed, and can continue improving with support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue regular check-ins, offer encouragement, and support Gary through the remaining challenges.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and is managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan for his support and says he feels more in control now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and may still need some support, but expects him to continue managing better.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now believes Gary no longer needs active intervention and can maintain a healthy balance independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier work-life balance, is capable of managing on his own, and knows Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active involvement while letting Gary know he is available if needed.
